description: Rust Boil reinforcement: bog-floor fusion after wave6 (the half-sunk dome kept reading as a head and grew a chassis 6/8; the two limbless nearest-misses were stump-rooted with OPEN crown-holes). The ground IS the body: swelling out of the bog floor, sunk to its midline, nothing beneath but mud; the seal pinned as an unbroken stretched drum-skin. New pose ids, fresh seeds.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink creature concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, one warm tallow light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture

subjects.prompt: a Rust Boil, a swollen dome of dark peat-flesh swelling directly out of the flat muddy bog floor like a giant sealed blister, fused into the ground at its base and sunk to its midline so nothing exists beneath it but mud, the single round opening at its crown capped flush with a stretched unbroken drum-skin of translucent amber tallow, old dried dark rust-brown stain trails fanning down from the crown rim, one yellow-brown fen-bone splinter jutting sideways from its flank, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, tallow gold, a single creature, pale misty background

a Rust Boil grown into the side of a low peat bank, a heavy swollen blister-dome of dark peat-flesh merging seamlessly into the bank's mud at its whole lower edge, the round crown opening sealed flush under a stretched unbroken disc of translucent amber tallow with a dull glow behind it, layered dried rust-brown stains running down its smooth swollen side, broken reeds around its base, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, tallow gold, a single creature, dark misty background

a Rust Boil swelling under inner pressure, a limbless dome of dark peat-flesh fused into the flat bog floor at its base, the stretched drum-skin of amber tallow over its crown bulging upward smooth and unbroken with a warm glow pressing through the strained wax, fine cracks of dried rust-brown stain webbing out from under the crown rim, the fen-bone splinter in its flank, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, tallow gold, a single creature, dark misty background

a Rust Boil alone on wide flat mud in thin fog, a distant swollen blister-dome of dark peat-flesh rising directly out of the level bog floor with no body beneath it, its crown sealed under a taut disc of amber tallow catching one warm light, long dried rust-brown stains down its flank, still puddles mirroring it, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, tallow gold, a single creature, pale misty background
